# dsh-stock-ticker
**A realtime stock watch mini-window for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.**
A draggable A-share watchlist panel with intraday curves, a hover detail card, and its own settings
page — shipped as a single dependency-free DSH plugin.

## Features
### The mini-window

One draggable, collapsible panel in the `shell.overlay` seat, showing every watched instrument.
Rows

inside the configured curve budget draw an intraday 分时 curve; hovering a row opens its full
detail

card — open/high/low/previous close, volume, turnover, turnover rate, amplitude, volume
ratio, marke

t cap, float cap, P/E/P/B, and the limit-up / limit-down prices — without reflowing the
list underne

, P/E/P/B, and the limit-up / limit-down prices — without reflowing the
list underneath the pointer.

**Placement is two separate acts.** Dragging the title bar moves the panel and keeps it there for
th

e session. The tack in the header is what makes a position durable, and while a panel is pinned
it i

s **locked**: the header stops being a drag handle (the grab cursor goes away) and attempts to
move

it do nothing. Press the tack again to unlock — the panel stays exactly where it is and becomes
drag
gable again — or use the settings page to clear the pin.

The tack follows the durable pin only, so its label always says what pressing it will do: 钉住 while
t

he panel is free, 取消钉住 while it is pinned. It never flips underneath a drag, which is what made
an e
arlier version look like it was jumping to the default corner.

- **A refused pin write does not move the panel.** The position is held locally until the section
co

nfirms it, so a Host that rejects the field (a half-updated deployment) leaves the panel where
it wa

s put. The control honestly reports that the pin did not stick, since a reload would lose the
positi

on.
- **A position saved on a larger window is corrected against the current one** before it is appl

ied,
so a resize can never strand the panel off screen where its only drag handle is unreachable.
### The watchlist page

A `settings.section` page named 股票盯盘. Search by code or Chinese name, add, reorder, and remove
instr

uments, and set how many get a curve, the refresh cadence, the panel's opacity, and whether the
mini
-window is shown at all.
### Correct by default for A-shares

A rise is red and a fall is green, including the curve stroke — the convention a mainland reader
exp

ects, not the Western one. This carries dedicated regression coverage because it was a reported
defe

defect.
## Requirements
| DeepSeek Harness | A desktop build whose web GUI serves `window.__DSH_BOOT__` and exposes the `she

ll.overlay` / `settings.section` extension seats |
| Node.js | `>= 20.3` (the host half uses `AbortS

ignal.any`) |
| Runtime dependencies | **None** |
| Network | Outbound HTTPS to `push2.eastmoney.com
`, `push2his.eastmoney.com`, and `searchapi.eastmoney.com` |

> The plugin targets mainland China A-share markets (Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing). It is not a
> gen
eral-purpose quote client for other exchanges.
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`lib/client.js` is hand-authored in the loader's factory form rather than compiled, so the package
s

hips no build step. It depends on nothing but the platform seed modules (`react` and
`@deepseek-ai/d

sh-client-ui-primitives`), and it resolves those defensively: every glyph is drawn
inline and the tw

o primitives fall back to native elements, so a renamed or removed export degrades
one control inste
ad of aborting the bundle.

For the design reasoning behind the backing selection, the caching layer, and the transport
policy,
see `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
### Why there is no build step
The harness's schema library is a peer of the harness rather than of a plugin, so a plugin installed
outside the harness's own module tree cannot resolve it. Carrying a hand-written validator keeps th

is
package installable anywhere — an absolute-path Loader row included — and free of version skew
ag
ainst the harness's schema release.
## Known limitations

- **Quote data is not attributed or licensed for redistribution.** The plugin reads a public
endpoin

t intended for a browser page; use it for personal monitoring.
- **A market session is approximated.

** Trading hours are computed from Beijing time and weekdays
only, so an exchange holiday costs a fe

w extra upstream requests rather than correctness — the flag
only drives a cache TTL and the refresh

cadence.
- **The watchlist is capped at 24 instruments**, which is also the per-request ceiling.
-

**Rows outside the curve budget fetch their curve on hover**, so the first hover on such a row
shows

its price cells before its card's chart fills in.
- **No pinned-session or multi-workspace scoping*

*: the overlay is root-scoped, so the watchlist is
the same in every session.
- **The upstream provi

der blocks eager clients.** Polling it from one address at a multi-second
cadence gets that address

throttled for a while, independently of this plugin. The cooldown limits
how much the plugin contrib

utes to that, but cannot make the provider more permissive; when it does
block, the panel says so an

d keeps showing the last values it received.
- **Detail-card labels follow the app locale**, resolve

d through the framework's translator with the
plugin's own dictionary as a deterministic fallback; a

locale the plugin does not ship falls back
to Chinese.
- **Everything the mini-window displays is u
ser-owned configuration**, not a hardcoded tunable.
